answer: The most common cause of invalid authenticator codes is device clock drift of more than thirty seconds. Please ask the user to check that automatic time synchronisation is enabled on the device generating the code. If the issue persists, you can also try signing in with one of their recovery codes and then re-enrolling a new device from the security page. If no recovery codes are available, an account administrator can reset multi-factor authentication for that user from the team members page.
